# Kinetiq builder quick reference

> Facts for coding agents building on Kinetiq (Hyperliquid): Elysium L2, kHYPE liquid staking, Markets by Kinetiq HIP-3 perps, Kinetiq Launch. Checked 2026-10-24. Every value is sourced in references/contracts.md. Testnet first; confirm every transaction with the user; never handle private keys.

## Networks
- HyperEVM mainnet: chain 999, RPC https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm, viem `hyperEvm`
- HyperEVM testnet: chain 998, RPC https://rpc.hyperliquid-testnet.xyz/evm, viem `hyperliquidEvmTestnet`
- Elysium testnet: chain 99801, gas HYPE, RPC https://testnet-rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz, explorer https://elysium.kinetiq.xyz/testnet-explorer, faucet https://elysium.kinetiq.xyz/testnet-faucet
- Elysium mainnet: announced for 9 Nov 2026; chain ID, RPC and addresses NOT PUBLISHED
- Hyperliquid API: POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info ; WS wss://api.hyperliquid.xyz/ws
- Markets trading API: https://trading-api.markets.xyz (mainnet only, hlk_ API key)

## kHYPE on HyperEVM mainnet (999)
- kHYPE token: 0xfD739d4e423301CE9385c1fb8850539D657C296D
- StakingManager (stake, queueWithdrawal, confirmWithdrawal): 0x393D0B87Ed38fc779FD9611144aE649BA6082109
- StakingAccountant (kHYPEToHYPE, HYPEToKHYPE): 0x9209648Ec9D448EF57116B73A2f081835643dc7A
- Min stake 5 HYPE; 0 for maxStakeAmount/stakingLimit means no cap; approve StakingManager before queueWithdrawal; exit about 8 to 9 days

## Markets by Kinetiq
- Live HIP-3 dex: `mkts` (USDC). Legacy `km` (USDH) fully delisted
- Live on 2026-10-24: mkts:US500, mkts:USTECH, mkts:SMALL2000, mkts:USBOND, mkts:BVIV
- Deployer of both dexes: kmHYPE StakingManager 0x71F0019cC7fa79E4f42587FB7b9a817D8d2429EC
- Book: {"type":"l2Book","coin":"mkts:US500"} ; markets: {"type":"metaAndAssetCtxs","dex":"mkts"}

## Elysium traps
- viem `elysiumTestnet` is chain 1338, not Kinetiq. Use defineChain id 99801. "99901" in posts is wrong
- No HyperEVM precompiles or CoreWriter on Elysium (until about 4 weeks after mainnet)
- `block.number` returns the HyperEVM block; use block.timestamp or ArbSys(0x64).arbBlockNumber()
- Plain transfer about 21,170 gas; no public mempool
- Verify: forge verify-contract ADDR src/X.sol:X --chain 99801 --verifier blockscout --verifier-url https://testnet.elysium.kinetiq.xyz/api/verify --skip-is-verified-check --watch
